title: System Instructions

body.text: rules the AI must follow for the whole conversation
— in ChatGPT you set them via Custom Instructions or when creating a Custom GPT, so you don't have to retype them every time.

example: "You are an HR assistant. Answer in polite Thai, always reference company policy, and if unsure, say to check with a real HR person"

title: Write effective system instructions

body.text: — the clearer it is, the less the AI drifts, and the more consistent its behavior throughout use.

example: "Role: math tutor / Scope: high school / Format: step-by-step with exercises / Restriction: don't give the answer directly, hint first"

question: How are system instructions different from a normal prompt?

options.text: They apply for the whole conversation, no retyping
They answer faster than a normal prompt

question: What should be in system instructions?

options.text: Role, scope, answer format, and restrictions

question: In ChatGPT, where do you set system instructions?

options.text: Custom Instructions in Settings, or when creating a Custom GPT
You can't — it's only in the API

question: To keep ChatGPT's behavior consistent across tasks, where should you set it?
What should good system instructions specify?

options.text: Role, constraints, and output format clearly
